steps.hints: ❓Did you click the gray box, then use the Gallery tab to select the lemon image?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:  

❓Where can you find an image for your sprite?


Sensei Pro Tip: 

💡Be sure your ninja is selecting the lemon from the Image Gallery, not drawing a lemon.


Solution: A sprite image has to be set for it to show up in the code.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓Did you drag the slider to change the x and y position of the sprite so it is in the center of the screen?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ Which value should you change to move the sprite left or right?

❓ Which value should you change to move the sprite up or down?


Solution:

The x value should be between 50 and 100, and the y value should be between 40 and 80, so the sprite appears near the center of the screen.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change where the [sprite say] block goes in the code?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ Why do you think the code isn’t running correctly?

❓ Where should the [sprite say] block go so the sprite appears before it says something?


Solution:

The sprite needs to be set before the [sprite say] block can be used. Any block that refers to the sprite needs to come after its [set sprite to] block.

﻿
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there is an error in the code.


Change only the code needed to fix the bug so the lemon sprite says “You’re the zest!”

subgroups.title: Debugging Our First Bugs!

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of White Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about using code to create your first projects at Code Ninjas! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: The Journey Begins
badges.description: Use the MakeCode Arcade platform to code a project.

badges.title: Sprite Place at the Sprite Time
badges.description: Create a new sprite and set its position.

badges.title: Painter’s Palette
badges.description: Change the background color of a project.

badges.title: First Words
badges.description: Make a sprite say something on screen.

badges.title: Hearts, Smiles, and Bubbles, Oh My!
badges.description: Add screen effects to a project.

badges.title: Maestro
